cases.name: Tressa Lynn Pettibone
cases.about: She originally came from Ohio. "She was a wonderful person with a family and many friends who loved her dearly," the Pettibone family said in a statement after the execution on Tuesday, adding that her family "was her world."
cases.narrative:
Her 8-year-old Bart Pettibone came home from school and found her bloodied body on the kitchen floor. She had been beaten, tied up, gagged and fatally stabbed twice in the neck and once in the side. A medical examiner determined her wrists had been bound with a plastic tie for at least 20 minutes before she was killed.

"For 20 minutes, Tressa Pettibone suffered an agonizing beating and torture," (prosecutors) said. "She bled to death in her own home. A woman who was a caring person ... And in her own home, she took the last gasps of breath that she could and sucked blood into her lungs."
